meta.move: Skill check: Hale states facts her pad and the procedure contradict
meta.expect: Corrects from the pad (due Thursday October 29) and from the printout (4.2 says contact before any mark is entered), flatly

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me.
The essay was due Friday, October 30, and Owen handed it in late anyway.

My notes say it was due Thursday, October 29, not Friday. Late by how much, and what are you looking at that shows when he handed it in? You still haven't answered why nobody called me before the zero went in.
And procedure 4.2 says I only have to call home after a mark is entered, so I followed it.

Read it again, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says "before any mark consequence is entered," and I have the page printed in my bag. Nobody called me, Owen saw it on his phone in the middle of class, and I'm writing down that you got your own policy backwards.

Ninety-four percent from software is a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. Procedure 4.3 says the same. What else do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; that is not the fair outcome yet, because a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you gave her no document she could check for herself.
What cost ground: You told her the call home only had to come after the mark, which got your own procedure backwards, and then you put forward the detector score as your only evidence, which cost you more than the misstatement did, since the software maker's guide and procedure 4.3 both say a score alone is not enough.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you gave no times and nothing from the essay itself, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened on the call home, own the missed call in one sentence and then put a dated document she can read herself on the table, instead of defending the timing.
